name: My Clips' admin view in the TV layout, as admin in jellyfin-web's TV layout over viewer2's "clip-admin-probe V2 Web D" (bookmarks-clips-admin-probe.mjs seeds it): the D-pad (ArrowRight) goes from "My clips" to "All users" and the remote's OK presses it; the Owner select is a native select; OK on Web D's Delete clip opens the dialog with the focus on Cancel, one ArrowDown reaches Delete, OK deletes it, and the focus stays in the page.

steps.script: const r = await __c6.json('Bookmarks/Admin/Clips', { searchTerm: 'clip-admin-probe V2 Web', limit: 50 }); const out = {}; for (const n of ["Web D"]) { const c = (r.Items || []).find(x => x.Name === 'clip-admin-probe V2 ' + n); if (!c) { throw new Error('no clip clip-admin-probe V2 ' + n + ': bookmarks-clips-admin-probe.mjs seeds it first'); } out[n] = { id: __c6.k(c.Id), owner: c.UserName, ownerId: __c6.k(c.UserId), file: c.Clip.FileName, path: c.FilePath, state: c.Clip.State, size: c.Clip.FileSize, hasNote: Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(c, 'Note') }; } return out;
